title: Seamless Holographic Fabric
content:
Just dropped a brand-new material on Connect, and I’m so excited to share this one with you all!

This is a seamless high-gloss holographic fabric with an iridescent liquid texture that shifts between chromatic waves and soft pearl reflections. It feels like molten light — surreal, fluid, and super vibrant.

![282f24ad3c7f411ab736331574c243cf](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/9d88eb5854ae40fbb136eb1b99e0b379/images/282f24ad3c7f411ab736331574c243cfmaterial%20preview%20o.png)

🌀 It tiles seamlessly for clean, uninterrupted flow, making it perfect for digital fashion, sci-fi looks, statement avatar outfits, or performance wear. I designed it to move with light and adapt across different silhouettes.

👗 I’ve included a set of full-body and close-up renders so you can see how it behaves across various forms — from fitted looks to voluminous shapes. Whether you’re rendering a dynamic runway shot or a still concept, this material holds its glow.

![0a0c05769c4e44f48f7883ea5a57743f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/9d88eb5854ae40fbb136eb1b99e0b379/images/0a0c05769c4e44f48f7883ea5a57743fmaterial%20preview%202.png)

![2c97cdc1ffc8447c81e40269812af39a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/9d88eb5854ae40fbb136eb1b99e0b379/images/2c97cdc1ffc8447c81e40269812af39amaterial%20preview%201.png)![f2f0ef7755e844ae8cbc84b00187d171](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/9d88eb5854ae40fbb136eb1b99e0b379/images/f2f0ef7755e844ae8cbc84b00187d171material%20preview%203.png)

🔍 Material specs:

• Seamless holographic tile (no visible breaks)

• High-gloss, layered print with pearlescent shine

• Stretchy and smooth finish

• Optimized for 3D fashion, avatars, and conceptual wearables

🖼️ Swipe through to view the renders

🛒 Available now on Connect: <https://connect.clo-set.com/detail/9eae8e91f487418e887475c9e33965be>

Let me know what you’d use it for! Tag me in your projects — I’d love to feature your creations. 🌐✨
content_description: Showcasing a new seamless high-gloss holographic fabric material designed for dynamic 3D fashion, avatars, and statement digital wearables.

title: Seamless Optical Illusion Fabric Design
content:
I’m excited to share one of my latest fabric designs — a seamless, high-gloss stretch material with a bold optical illusion print. The wavy lines in red, cyan, yellow, and white move fluidly over a black base, creating a dynamic, colorful effect that shifts beautifully with movement and light.

![cacf8e7292664679ba70ce95c824bbba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/765395c5a68a45f391b3b0c4e5b8256f/images/cacf8e7292664679ba70ce95c824bbbamaterial%20preview%202_1.png)

This fabric isn’t just about the look. The seamless print means there are no visible breaks or repetitions, making it perfect for designs that need a clean, continuous flow — whether in digital fashion, activewear, or stage costumes. The stretch performance and glossy finish add an extra layer of depth and shine, making every piece stand out.

![b2f6a590072442ffb7efa333c623e1c4](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/765395c5a68a45f391b3b0c4e5b8256f/images/b2f6a590072442ffb7efa333c623e1c4set%20top%20cut_1.png)

🧵 Material details:

• Seamless chromatic print (no visible pattern breaks)

• High-gloss, stretch performance fabric

• Smooth, second-skin feel

• Digital print with layered chromatic edge effect

• Great for activewear, avatar clothing, 3D fashion, and statement pieces

✨ I designed this material for creators who want something vibrant and flexible — a fabric that works as well in motion as it does in static designs.

![72799a438a4043779dc3e1ae9e9bfa17](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/765395c5a68a45f391b3b0c4e5b8256f/images/72799a438a4043779dc3e1ae9e9bfa17material%20preview%201_1.png)

![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/765395c5a68a45f391b3b0c4e5b8256f/images/9cbd12468781469f82ee03e1c7940058material%20preview%20o_3.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/765395c5a68a45f391b3b0c4e5b8256f/images/2645de3681f040928ab83a95c06edac8tumbnail.png)

title: Seashell Whispers
content:
🐚💗 The beach called... and I answered with ruffles!

Stripes, shells and soft pink dreams — ready to walk straight into a crochet summer.

A pastel dream in crochet. This maxi striped dress combines soft blue and pink tones with shell-shaped 3D appliqués and sculptural ruffles flowing along the hem. Accompanied by a wide sunhat and delicate textures, it evokes a nostalgic and playful beachside fantasy.

![7e3b20bd95c248b2bf1964950e580f7e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/755c77832d7546479b9990f486a6a49d/images/7e3b20bd95c248b2bf1964950e580f7e1_21.png)![9f1cc076921c433e889c9eb3ba1268da](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/755c77832d7546479b9990f486a6a49d/images/9f1cc076921c433e889c9eb3ba1268da2_60.png)![93c3d572cbb14611a9129a71003fbeba](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/755c77832d7546479b9990f486a6a49d/images/93c3d572cbb14611a9129a71003fbeba1_142.png)![67b134ae391a4490b1cf3817e364e74e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/755c77832d7546479b9990f486a6a49d/images/67b134ae391a4490b1cf3817e364e74e2_124%20%281%29.png)![7a06ab4a00fa475bbba03b427b9db2f4](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/755c77832d7546479b9990f486a6a49d/images/7a06ab4a00fa475bbba03b427b9db2f41_322.png)

title: Object not stable in freeze state
content:
Hi,

Object not stable in freeze state, as after freezing when i am working on

another object the freezing object shows changing.

Regards,

Neeraj

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi. Can you please add images or a screen recording so we can see what is happening

Comment 2: not like that, different

Comment 3: Hi! Is the freezed object a symmetrical pattern to the pattern you are editing?
Reply 1: hi,Sorry for the delay response .Yes it is symmetrical pattern.
Reply 2: That is the reason. When you edit symmetrical/instance pattern it will edit the freezed twin the same way. The freezing is useful for simulations, so that the good simulated pattern is not affected by simulation of a new pattern piece.
content_description: This web page aims to address and provide solutions for issues related to object instability after freezing in design or modeling software.
